subject: avoid unsafe code in ValkeySearch::Info  during crashdump (#98)
reason: The change only affects ValkeySearch::Info when invoked with for_crash_report set, i.e. from inside Valkey's crash-dump signal handler: it skips module INFO sections that take locks, allocate, or need the main thread. The normal INFO path (for_crash_report=0) emits exactly the same sections and fields on both builds, so no client-visible reply, replication, persistence or topology behaviour differs — a compared sequence would have no command that could carry expect_difference. The changed path can only be reached by crashing the server mid-dump, which the fuzzer's liveness oracle treats as a f
